title: When 9 Beats 10
headline: WHEN 9 BEATS 10
synopsis: The installer kept picking rc.9 over rc.10, because GitHub sorts releases by name. Now it picks by date.
altText: A 16-bit game strip. Panel 1: Sam watches an installer proudly announce rc.9. Panel 2: Kit the fox points at a leaderboard where rc.9 sits above rc.10, sorted like words. Panel 3: a calendar power-up drops; rc.10 takes first place and Sam cheers.

panels.scene: Sam at a retro computer; the screen proudly flashes an install message
Kit the fox points at a high-score leaderboard where rc.9 sits above rc.10
A calendar power-up drops from above; rc.10 jumps to first place while Sam cheers
